mission.title: Regulator
mission.description: Take control of Ouroboros and find the source of its troubles.

npc.say: I say, I will not stand for this...this seizure of the sweat of our brow!
Me? Well, I... I refill the snack machines.
Doesn't matter to me. I only use it for email and web browsing, and I haven't been able to get online here in weeks.
I would just like to take this opportunity to state that I had nothing whatsoever to do with whatever it was.

phase.briefing:
Operative, the time has come to assume control of Ouroboros. Whatever entity is manipulating the company nearly destroyed a large area of Downtown by overloading the power plant in their Creston Heights headquarters. We have been patient, because we do not want those hiding behind the company's facade, the Oligarchs, to be alerted to problems here, but the threat from those problems, including city-wide rioting only now being brought under control, can no longer be overlooked. Furthermore, we must consider the possibility that the Oligarchs themselves may be behind these problems, although why they would endanger their own front company is unknown.
We have already frozen the corporation's assets. With their infrastructure near collapse, employees in separate offices must be notified in person. Please proceed.

enter.say: Hey, it's a federal bailout. Considering the hell their company's been through in the past month, they should welcome us with open arms...right?

done.say: See? We're keeping bread on tables here.

phase.briefing: {player}, a junior operative reported a problem at the Ouroboros office to which they were assigned. This facility serves Ouroboros security personnel. Some of these individuals have objected to our takeover of the company.

enter.say: Some people... So they think they're better off with the entire corporation heading for self-destruction? Well, up to us to knock some sense into them.

objective.text: Kill all of the Ouroboros Security

done.say: That should do it for the morons.

phase.briefing: Thank you, operative. Now that our agents completed notification of Ouroboros staff, we can begin collecting the corporation's internal data. Analysis of this data will provide the surest means of finding the cause of the company's crisis.

enter.say: All right, you're basically going to be going around to their terminals and running a small script that will upload their data to one of our servers for analysis.

done.say: Nooo! My record! Months of screen saving...ruined!

near.say: There's no way you're winning this. My screen saver kicked in a few seconds before yours did. I'm going to set the all-time record!
Aw, you just wait. I'll catch up!

complete.say: Right. Shouldn't take them long to churn through this stuff.

phase.briefing: {player}, an analysis of the Ouroboros data coming in from all of our operatives has led to an important discovery. I would like you to join me at the Ouroboros office indicated on your display.

enter.say: Phew. Here's hoping this is the end of the rat race.

talk.say:
A series of suspect directives and programs, disseminated through a network of employees, were found to originate from this terminal. It is unique in that it is not connected to the Ouroboros Corporation's network; its connection ran outside the simulation, to the Oligarch Network.
While we have yet to track down all of the messages and employees involved, the evidence points to this connection as the source of the malfunctions within the company. We can only conclude that the Oligarchs are now firmly aware of the situation, and will not hesitate to intrude into the Matrix once again.

done.say: Oligarch attention will have serious ramifications, as you will no doubt realize if you recollect the problems encountered with the two who have entered the Matrix to date: Halborn and Carlyne.

near.say: It appears that someone has removed all of the...staplers from this facility.
Perhaps you would care for some...coffee, {player}?
What do you think this is? An audit?

mission.finish: We must prepare to deal with problems beyond merely the domestic variety, operative. You will be contacted again.
